q: Which rotator‑cuff muscle inserts on the anterior aspect of the {{humerus|linkinternal}}?
Is the {{trsmin|linkinternal}} muscle generally visible on the surface?
c: Visible only when the arm is abducted and externally rotated
a: {{trsmin|linktitle}} is one of the four {{rotator_cuff|linkinternal}} muscles. It sits deep beneath the {{dt|linkinternal}} and {{trz|linkinternal}} and is covered by dense fascia along with {{infs|linkinternal}}. In most individuals and most positions, it is not visible on the surface.
